note: Offsets and metadata only. No game graphics are stored in this repository; sprites are decoded on the player's device from ROMs they import.

confidence.rom-verified: Bytes decoded from the ROM and checked against an independent export or hash.
confidence.visual-candidate: Role assigned by looking at decoded frames; not yet confirmed by a runtime trace.
confidence.unverified: Recalled or estimated; must be checked against the game.
confidence.ai-set: Sequence number read from the AI code that sets it (CurAnim / sprite object anim); the frames themselves are the ROM's.

mettaur.label: Mettaur
mettaur.note: Variant palettes: slot = variant index (0 base, 1 "2", 2 "3", 3 Ω, 4 Rare, 5 Rare2); visually confirmed.

shockwave.label: ShockWave (SHOCKWAVE_B1)
shockwave.note: Sprite ID 0xB1 in the flat sprite table; offsets differ by version, bytes identical.

target.label: Gunner crosshair (MACHINE_GUN_TARGET_D5)
target.note: Sprite ID 0xD5; offsets differ by version, bytes identical.

elecman.label: ElecMan (BN6)
elecman.note: AI sets CurAnim 0x12/0x13 (charge, charged), 0x14/0x15 (summon, point), 0xF/0x10/0x11 (dash ready, dash, strike); read from the ElecMan AI code.

protoman.label: ProtoMan (BN6)
protoman.note: AI sets these animation numbers directly (CurAnim 3,4,5,15 read from the ProtoMan AI code); guard pose is a candidate.

elecbolt.label: ElecMan lightning (sprite table 0x10/0x12)
elecbolt.note: Loaded by ElecMan attack object type3 0x1E via sprite_load(0x80, 0x10, 0x12).

eleccoil.label: ElecMan coil (object type3 0x19)
eleccoil.note: sprite_load(0x80, 0x10, 0x13). Sequences: 0 spawn, 1 idle, 2 discharge (column lightning).

swordfx.label: Sword slash effect (effect objects 0x25/0x27 → sprite list 0xC index 0x14)
swordfx.note: Shape-to-sequence mapping (wide 0, long 1, sword 2) is visual; effect table 0x80E0398 lists animations 3 and 0 for ids 0x25/0x27.

heatman.label: HeatMan (BN6)
heatman.note: AI sets CurAnim 3/4 (appear/vanish), 0xF aim, 0x10 arm, 0x11 close into lighter, 0x13 box, 0x15 fire; read from HeatMan AI code.

nozzle.label: Flame nozzle (object type3 0x27)
nozzle.note: sprite_load(0x80, 0x10, 0x1B). Wall-mounted nozzle; drawn for a right-facing flame.

slashman.label: SlashMan (BN6)
slashman.note: AI sets CurAnim 3/4, 0xF ready, 0x10 down swipe, 0x11 side swipe, 0x12 crouch, 0x13 spin, 0x14 claws up, 0xC throw; read from SlashMan AI code.

eraseman.label: EraseMan (BN6; JP KillerMan)
eraseman.note: Animation ids from the AI code (0x11 raise, 0x12 hold, 0x13 wind-up, 0x14 swing) match the sprite sequences directly.

chargeman.label: ChargeMan (BN6)
chargeman.note: AI animation ids 0xF run, 0x10 whistle, 0x11 rush map to sequences 15-17 directly.

spoutman.label: SpoutMan (BN6; AquaMan in BN4)
spoutman.note: AI animation ids 0xF-0x15 map to sequences 15-21 directly.

tomahawkman.label: TomahawkMan (BN6)
tomahawkman.note: AI animation ids 7, 0xC, 0xF-0x12 map to sequences directly.

tenguman.label: TenguMan (BN6)
tenguman.note: AI animation ids 0xF-0x16 map to sequences directly; 0x12-0x14 are the flying dash poses.

groundman.label: GroundMan (BN6)
groundman.note: AI animation ids 0x11-0x16 map to sequences directly; the drill clones in 0xB use this sprite too (sequences 23/24).

dustman.label: DustMan (BN6)
dustman.note: AI animation ids 0xF-0x17 map to sequences directly; the thrown junk (type3 0x83) uses sequence 24 of this sprite.

blastman.label: BlastMan (BN6)
blastman.note: LZ77-compressed. AI animation ids 5, 7, 9-0xC map to sequences directly; his fire objects (type3 0x1F/0x20/0x21) use sequences 13-18 of this same sprite.

diveman.label: DiveMan (BN6)
diveman.note: LZ77-compressed. AI animation ids 3-8 map to sequences directly (3 = submerged periscope); the wave (20), torpedo (23/24) and splash (25) are sequences of this same sprite.

circusman.label: CircusMan (BN6)
circusman.note: LZ77-compressed, 64 sequences: body 0-19 (tent 14-18), separate hand layers 20-59 (not drawn here), giant hands 60/61, hoop 62, lion 63. AI animation ids map to sequences directly.

judgeman.label: JudgeMan (BN6)
judgeman.note: LZ77-compressed, 19 sequences. AI animation ids 5-7 map to sequences directly; whip 8/9, press books 10/11, law book 13-18.

lawbook.label: JudgeMan law book (object type3 0x70; same sprite as JudgeMan)

elementman.label: ElementMan (BN6)
elementman.note: LZ77-compressed, 20 sequences: body 0-8, element ring 9-17, rising tower 18/19. The attack objects (type3 0x8D-0x90, type4 0x57) use other sprites not yet registered.

colonel.label: Colonel (BN6)
colonel.note: LZ77-compressed, 33 sequences: body 0-12, cape layers 13-29 (not drawn), missile 30-32.

bass.label: Bass (BN6)
bass.note: LZ77-compressed, 47 sequences: body 0-19, cape 20-39 (sequence n+20 is the cape for body sequence n, drawn over the body; attack poses throw it back to show his arms), projectiles 40-46.

gregar.label: Cybeast Gregar (BN6 Gregar)
gregar.note: Only the Gregar ROM carries the full battle sprite (sprite table category 8, index 0x14); the Falzar ROM's entry at that index is a small 31-sequence block, so a Falzar-only install falls back to the Gregar ROM if it is imported, else placeholder art. 86 sequences: five stacked layers of 16 animations, drawn in sequence order: 0-15 shadow, 16-31 hind feet, 32-47 torso and tail, 48-63 legs with shoulder/hip joints, 64-79 head and mane; effects 80-85. Order matches the game's composite (checked against reference art).

falzar.label: Cybeast Falzar (BN6 Falzar)
falzar.note: Only the Falzar ROM carries the full battle sprite (sprite table category 8, index 0x15); the Gregar ROM's entry at that index is a small 31-sequence block, so a Gregar-only install falls back to the Falzar ROM if it is imported, else placeholder art. 44 sequences: four layers of 10 animations (0-9 back wing, 10-19 body, 20-29 head, 30-39 front wing; animation ids 0x14-0x1D), shadow 40, effects 41-43. Animation 9 is the drill form. The body is drawn in the air (its talons hang ~66 px below the sprite origin) and the shadow (40) separately on the ground under his head.

elmeteor.label: ElementMan aqua attack drop (object type3 0x8D, sprite 0xC/0x31)

elsparkle.label: ElementMan wood attack sparkle (object type3 0x8E, sprite 0x10/0x0F)

darkmech.label: DarkMech (BN6 virus, AI 25)
darkmech.note: Body seq n is drawn with its separate sword object at seq n+6 (AI 0x8113840 sets both).

snakearm.label: SnakeArm (BN6 virus, AI 26)
snakearm.note: AI 0x81144B4: CurAnim 1-4 by quarter of the leap, 0 = in a hole.

craggerarm.label: Cragger rock fist (object type1 0x02, sprite 0x10/0x30; plays Cragger's own animation number)

cannonarm.label: Cannon / HiCannon / M-Cannon arm (t1 0x5 entries 0–2, palette 0/1/2), sprite 0x0C/0x01

throwball.label: Thrown ball: in MegaMan's hand (t1 0x5 entry 4, animation 0) and in flight (t3 0x8, animation 1); MiniBomb uses palette 0, sprite 0x0C/0x02

busterflash.label: Buster muzzle flash (t1 0x5 entry 5, arm offset 0x10), sprite 0x0C/0x06

airshotarm.label: AirShot gun (t1 0x5 entry 0x13, arm offset 0xA), sprite 0x0C/0x18

vulcanarm.label: Vulcan gun (t1 0x5 entry 0xD, arm offset 0xE), sprite 0x0C/0x1D

hitfx.label: Hit spark (hit effect 0 → t4 0x4 table 0x80E0804), sprite 0x14/0x05

explosionfx.label: Explosion (hit effect 7; Cannon via t3 0x0 entry 1), sprite 0x14/0x01

swordarm.label: Sword blade held by MegaMan (t1 0x5 entry 3 for every sword subfamily, byte_80EBB64), sprite 0x0C/0x00

vulcanhitfx.label: Vulcan hit (t3 0x12 entry 0xC → effect object 0x20), sprite 0x14/0x0F

deletefx.label: Deletion burst (effect object 3, spawned twice by the deletion routine 0x801746E), sprite 0x14/0x03

capsulefx.label: Capsule puff (t4 0x14, 0x80E1CF8): sprite 0x14/0x02, animation 1, palette from Param1 (0)

chargefx.label: Buster charge aura (t4 0x8, chargeShotChargeObject_80E0DF0): sprite 0x14/0x08 for the B charge (0x14/0x15 for the other button), palette 2 (effect table 0x80E0398 entry 8), animation = charge state

tables.note: BN6 sprite pointer table (flat sprite ID index, bit 31 = LZ77) and virus stats tables; see tools/extract_bn6_viruses.py

field.label: Battle field panels (BG tiles LZ77 → VRAM 0x6001460, tilemaps byte_86DFA98, palettes 0x86E08F8 + animations 0x800C1DC)
field.note: Tilemap entry for panel animation a (= panel type 0–12), side s (0 red, 1 blue), row r (1–3): ((a·6 + s·3 + r) − 1) × 32 bytes, 5×3 BG entries (0x800C01C). Tile index − tileBase indexes the decompressed tiles. Palette n is BG palette n (0 = palette0, 1–8 = palettes + 32·(n−1)). Palette animations cycle each listed palette through its frames (src, frames) (0x800C192).

chipart.label: Chip icons (16×16) and pictures (56×48) via ChipDataArr pointers; icon palette from the in-battle icon loader (0x802707C)
chipart.note: ChipDataArr record (0x2C bytes) + 0x20: icon tiles, picture tiles (7×6 tiles, raw 4bpp), picture palette. Icons: 2×2 tiles, shared palette.

customscreen.label: Custom screen: frame tiles (tile 0 at tiles), tilemap byte_86E625C (byte_86E64B4 with CrossSelect), palettes byte_86E587C (4, by chip class), code strips dword_86E591C, damage digits dword_86E411C, element icons dword_86E3598 + colour sets byte_86E3B18, code letters dword_86E2E98 (8×16, at tile (2,9)); selected-chip column: side tiles 0x88/0x89 of the frame tiles (h-flipped on the right), 16×16 boxes dword_86E601C with palette 0x872CFF4 (Gregar 0x872AF30); battle message font: 8×16 glyphs A–Z, bar fill, '!', bar ends at 0x86F133C (Gregar 0x86EF2C0), palette 0x86F2900 (Gregar 0x86F0884); battle text font dword_86B7AE0 (Gregar 0x86B5A2C), 64 bytes per character code (charmap: space 0, digits 1–10, A–Z 0x0B, a–z 0x26), palette 13 = dword_86E1C78 (Gregar 0x86DFBFC); battle HUD: custom gauge word_801ED6C and HP box byte_801EDFC with their tiles and palettes (see src/rom/custom.mjs)
customscreen.note: Layout from the tile rects in byte_8027B2C (0x80268AC): name 8×2 tiles at (2,1), picture 7×6 at (2,3), element 2×2 at (3,9), damage 3×2 at (6,9), 10 slots (icon 2×2 + code 2×1) from (1,13) every 2 tiles across and 3 down, selected column 2×10 at (12,3). Frame pixel-checked against the owner's screenshot (0 differing pixels outside the layers the game draws later). Column pixel-checked against the owner's custom-screen sheet; the box palette was found by its colours (one match in the ROM), not traced to code. Font located by matching the owner's font sheet against the ROM's tiles (one match); the glyph order was read from the tiles. The code that composes the banners was not traced. The chip name line uses BG palette 13 (byte_801D944) with no colour shift; palette 13 is dword_86E1C78, loaded to 0x3001B00 by list off_801ECB4 (BG palette 0 = 0x3001960).

menus.label: BN6 menu screens: CHIP FOLDER (chipFolder_initGfx_812386C) and FOLDER EDIT (0x8133EC0). Each entry is the address of the screen's palette list (src, variant, dest, size) and decompAndCopyData list (src | LZ flag, dest, size), read from the ROM itself.
menus.note: Decoded on device by src/rom/menus.mjs. Gregar's code for these menus sits 0x1DDC later than Falzar's. Gregar's palettes are green (the owner's screenshots), Falzar's orange. Background settings: screen mode 0x10 (byte_8001618): BG1 tiles 0x6000000, BG0 0x6008000. Chip descriptions: TextScriptChipDescriptions0 (ids 0–255) and TextScriptChipDesc1 (256+), pointers at 0x8027D50 in both versions.
